results.title: DAP backs AUKU repeal, urges wider reforms in education, economy
results.description: DAP backs Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s plan to abolish AUKU, calling for wider reforms in education, the economy and cost of living, with Loke stressing the need for decisive implementation.
